claims.claim: Avoid unattended kernel or GPU driver changes during active rentals. Driver and kernel updates can break running jobs or leave the host in a driver/library mismatch state until rebooted. Plan updates during maintenance windows, then verify `nvidia-smi`, Docker GPU access, and self-test behavior before accepting new rentals.
